title: Printable Bullet Journal Tracker Bundle, Undated Yearly Planner (PDF)
claim: A search for lock-in trackers on Etsy returned only generic tracker bundles, which suggests generic supply is heavy and trend-named supply is limited.
excerpt: Summary listed Year-in-Pixels ($1.70), a monthly tracker grid ($3.95) and a 40+ page tracker bundle; prices about $1-6.
